title: Complications and Clinical Response in Cancer Patients Treated With Anti-VEGF-Related Therapies
official: A Prospective Study Evaluating Complications and Clinical Response in Cancer Patients Treated With Anti-VEGF-Related Therapies
summary: This study collects information about complications and clinical response in cancer patients treated with anti-VEGF-related therapies. This study aims to observe side effects that may happen to patients with advanced cancer who are treated with anti-VEGF related therapy. This may help doctors learn if there are any relationships between these side effects and how the disease may respond to treatment.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients must be able to understand and be willing to sign a written informed consent document
* Patients must be receiving any anti-VEGF-related regimen in monotherapy or combination therapy
